verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Warehouse Native, which runs experiment analysis directly in the customer's data warehouse. It also documents custom ingested events that are explicitly used for metric calculation and experiment outcomes, so experiment metrics can draw on the team's own data. However, the pack never shows how a metric is actually defined from a warehouse table or event, such as a metric-source or SQL definition workflow. missing for 10: explicit docs on defining metrics from warehouse tables or SQL, metric definition workflow for events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.
Logs one or more custom events for analytics and metric calculation. Events are used to measure experiment outcomes and user behavior.
Modern statistical engine for running analyses on existing experiments from third-party or internal systems.
